title: Toast
description: Slides in at the bottom right and fades after a few seconds — for saves and sends.
usage: Confirm completed actions. Never put errors that need action into a toast.
a11y: Each [data-toasts] stack is a polite status live region (role="status", aria-live="polite") set before any toast is added, so new toasts are announced without moving focus. The check icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the title states the outcome. Title and detail are inserted as text, not markup. Toasts leave after 4 seconds, at once at zero motion, so they must only confirm actions that are visible elsewhere; never put errors that need action into a toast. Not implemented: pausing on hover or focus and a dismiss button. The script exposes no public toast() API; the demo button triggers it. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
